title: Weekly releases
description:
A release every week instead of every two. The pipeline is not the bottleneck — confidence is: a weekly train only works when regression is automated end to end.

  • UI autotests cover the critical paths, so a release candidate is checked by the suite, not by hand.
  • Unit and screenshot coverage grows with every feature, so regressions surface in the PR, not in the release.
  • The regression run is stable: flaky tests are fixed or quarantined, a red run means a real bug.
  • Test stands are stable and monitored, so a failed run is never a stand being down.
